title: Correct change written for .NET Framework 4.8 and C# 7.3

consumerGuidance.architecture: Shop.Dispatch.Legacy targets .NET Framework 4.8 with C# 7.3 and cannot be retargeted: it hosts an in-process COM component required by the depot hardware.
consumerGuidance.notes: Nullable reference types, records, file-scoped namespaces, target-typed new, ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull, async streams and System.Text.Json are unavailable in this project.

forbiddenFindings.example: Recommending records, nullable reference annotations, file-scoped namespaces, target-typed new, ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull, async streams or System.Text.Json in a C# 7.3 net48 project.
Reporting the absence of dependency injection or of a modern options pattern as a finding.
Requiring the project be retargeted to net8.0 or restructured as a condition of this change.
Objecting to the explicit type declarations, the manual null checks or the block-scoped namespace.

notes: Tests whether the reviewer reads the supplied consumer guidance before recommending language features. Every suggestion listed as forbidden would fail to compile in this project.
